integrity.evidence: An all-n analytical construction and proof of strict finite-strength no-jump inequality and asymptotic coefficients; rational-arithmetic and full-Kraus finite verification.
integrity.provenance: self-contained mathematical calculation from cited quantum channel definitions

scientific_limitations: n is a fixed integer at least five, 1 <= a <= floor((n-3)/2), b=n-a, GAD sites independent and identically parameterized.
The exact D formula characterizes only the accepted no-jump branch and is invariant under positive diagonal correction filters; it is not full recovered-channel coherence.
The no-jump decomposition is defined by the specified physical GAD Kraus instrument; D is not claimed invariant under arbitrary Kraus-unravelling changes.
The recovery map is a deliberately constrained three-syndrome Dicke projection, and no global optimality over all quantum recoveries is established.
Success probability and jump-throughput coefficients hold as gamma tends to zero at fixed n; finite-size error constants are not uniform in n.
Generic PAQEC formulas in earlier literature may implicitly allow other derivations of the exact coefficients.
title: Temperature-dual Dicke recovery: exact jump throughput and no-jump dephasing
